never: put a number in the evidence range that is not a recorded, verified sale
widen a selection rule quietly to reach the minimum count
merge the agent's estimate into the evidence range or present it as what the evidence says
use a withheld or unverified price in the arithmetic
send a version to the vendor the agent has not approved
edit or delete the record of what was shown
stays_with_person: the agent's own estimate and the price they quote
approving each version before the vendor sees it
what to do when the quoted price sits below the evidence
anything said to the vendor about the price

provider_block.job: the vendor sees where the price came from, and you can prove it later

with_us.note: No hosted step. Live recorded sales, from a source the agency already licenses, with a source a person can follow, and a durable record of what was shown on what date, are the step not to hand-roll, and they are quoted as a scoped build.

checks.title: The subject property comes from a record
The selection rules are written down before any sale is chosen
Every comparable shown meets every stated rule
Each comparable carries its source and its sale date
A withheld or unverified price is never part of the range
Too few comparables means no range, and the page says so
The range is worked out from the comparables and nothing else
The agent's estimate is shown separately, labelled as theirs
A quoted price below the evidence is flagged to the agent
Stale data is held, not shown as current
The agent approves the exact version before the vendor sees it
What was shown, and when, is recorded and never overwritten
